target.title: fix(matrix): recognize MiniMax mm: namespaced reasoning tags in monitor replies
target.body:
Related: #89473

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Matrix users could see MiniMax reasoning-only monitor replies when the reply text used MiniMax `mm:` thinking tags such as `<mm:think>`, `<mm:thinking>`, or `<mm:thought>`.

Without this patch, the Matrix monitor reply delivery path could treat those hidden reasoning blocks as ordinary visible text and send them into the Matrix room.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Matrix already suppresses reasoning-only replies before `sendMessageMatrix`; this change aligns that Matrix-local classifier with the MiniMax `mm:` thinking-tag namespace used by sibling reasoning-tag paths.
- The fix is intentionally narrow: it only expands the existing Matrix thinking-tag regex family and keeps the send pipeline, auth/config behavior, room/thread behavior, media delivery, migrations, dependencies, and public plugin API unchanged.
- A focused regression test locks in that three `mm:` reasoning-only replies are dropped while a normal visible answer in the same batch still sends.

## User Impact

Matrix users no longer receive hidden MiniMax reasoning text when a monitor reply contains only `mm:`-namespaced thinking tags. Visible Matrix replies continue to send normally.

## Evidence

- Branch base checked during freshness gate: `origin/main` at `4ae8d735bf`. The branch was synced with main via merge commit `62e38b010f` because the user requested a main sync; no rebase was performed.
- Real behavior proof:
  - **Behavior or issue addressed:** MiniMax `mm:` reasoning-only Matrix monitor replies should be suppressed before Matrix send, while a normal visible answer should still reach the room.
  - **Real environment tested:** disposable unencrypted Matrix room on the matrix.org homeserver, viewed in Element; OpenClaw v2026.6.11; Node 24.15.0; synced worktree SHA `62e38b010f`.
  - **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
    ```bash
    NODE_OPTIONS=--use-env-proxy pnpm exec tsx matrix-mm-live-proof-proxy.ts --env-file matrix-external.env
    ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-matrix.config.ts extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts --reporter=verbose
    git diff --check origin/main..HEAD
    ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --deny=warn --ignore-path=.oxlintignore extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.ts extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts
    ```
  - **Evidence after fix:**
    ```text
    [matrix-runtime] matrix reply suppressed as reasoning-only
    [matrix-runtime] matrix reply suppressed as reasoning-only
    [matrix-runtime] matrix reply suppressed as reasoning-only
    Matrix mm: live room proof passed
    proof_id=pr94038-20260620014039
    proof_environment=external-room
    transport=external-matrix-http-api-via-proxy
    homeserver_host=matrix-client.matrix.org
    room_id=!MDPQ…IsRx:matrix.org
    bot_user_id=@xing…8:matrix.org
    send_count=1
    event_body_contains_visible_answer=true
    event_body_contains_reasoning_markers=false
    sent_payloads_contain_reasoning_markers=false
    result=[local path redacted]
    ```
    ```text
    ✓ |extension-matrix| extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts > deliverMatrixReplies > keeps replyToId on first reply only when replyToMode=first 19ms
    ✓ |extension-matrix| extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts > deliverMatrixReplies > keeps replyToId on every reply when replyToMode=all 1ms
    ✓ |extension-matrix| extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts > deliverMatrixReplies > keeps replyToId when threadId is set so Matrix can send fallback metadata 0ms
    ✓ |extension-matrix| extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts > deliverMatrixReplies > suppresses reasoning-only text before Matrix sends 0ms
    ✓ |extension-matrix| extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts > deliverMatrixReplies > suppresses MiniMax mm: namespaced reasoning-only replies before Matrix sends 0ms
    ✓ |extension-matrix| extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts > deliverMatrixReplies > uses supplied cfg for chunking and send delivery without reloading runtime config 1ms
    ✓ |extension-matrix| extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts > deliverMatrixReplies > passes raw media captions through to sendMessageMatrix without pre-converting them 0ms

    Test Files  1 passed (1)
         Tests  7 passed (7)
    ```
  - **Observed result after fix:** the live Matrix room received exactly one message, `Visible answer pr94038-20260620014039`. Three `mm:` reasoning-only replies were suppressed, the fetched Matrix event contained the visible answer, and neither the sent payload nor the fetched Matrix event contained the hidden reasoning markers. After syncing with `origin/main`, the PR diff is still confined to `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.ts` and `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts`, and the focused Matrix regression test still passes at `62e38b010f`.
  - **What was not tested:** a full gateway conversation driven by a live MiniMax model stream. The external Matrix room proof was not rerun after the July 8 main sync because the disposable Matrix credentials and proof harness are not present in this workspace; the synced diff preserves the same Matrix delivery-boundary change and reran the focused regression test at the synced head.
- Regression tests and local checks:
  ```text
  ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-matrix.config.ts extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts --reporter=verbose
  Result: passed, 1 test file, 7 tests.

  git diff --check origin/main..HEAD
  Result: passed.

  ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --deny=warn --ignore-path=.oxlintignore extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.ts extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts
  Result: passed.

  git diff --stat origin/main..HEAD
  Result: 2 files changed, 28 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-).
  ```

## Regression Test Plan

- Coverage level: Unit test plus live Matrix send/read proof at the Matrix monitor delivery boundary.
- Target test file: `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/replies.test.ts`
- Scenario locked in: `<mm:think>`, `<mm:thinking>`, and `<mm:thought>` reasoning-only replies are suppressed before Matrix sends, while `Visible answer` still sends once.
- Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail: the bug is in Matrix's send/no-send classifier, so the test exercises `deliverMatrixReplies` directly and asserts the actual `sendMessageMatrix` boundary.

## Root Cause

- Root cause: Matrix's local reasoning-only classifier recognized bare, `antml:`, and `antthinking` tags, but omitted MiniMax's `mm:` namespace for `think`, `thinking`, and `thought` tags.
- Missing detection / guardrail: the Matrix reply tests covered bare reasoning suppression but did not include MiniMax `mm:` namespaced reasoning-only replies with a visible-answer control.
